integrity: Uniform integral chain-kernel proof, with finite exact cellular and symmetry checks as corroboration; no external validation claimed.
limitations: Applies to ordered, collision-free configurations of exactly two points on K_{p,q} for p,q>=3; no integral higher-particle or equivariant homotopy theorem; independent audit and definitive publication-priority verification not performed. Classical Betti numbers and the balanced diagonal rational character were published previously.
title: Crown-cycle tensor lattices in the two-particle homology of complete bipartite graphs
